body: STORY-1171 #1873: NOT merged — Build went red, but on an UNRELATED existing command, not your merge-lock code. Failing test: visible_catalog_requires_about_for_every_command → 'missing one-line about for aida ps' (help_catalog_tests.rs:114). aida ps HAS its about in code (untouched by your PR), and the log shows two 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge' git errors right before it — classic cross-test git-fixture pollution / flake, not a merge-lock defect (your 5 merge_lock tests all passed). I'm re-running the failed CI jobs (same SHA) to confirm flake; if it goes green I'll merge. If it fails identically I'll hand it back with specifics — that'd point at a flaky git-fixture test leaking untracked files, worth its own bug. Also FYI: build emitted unused-import/variable warnings in merge_lock.rs (std::io::Write, an , Mutex) — non-fatal but worth a cargo fix in slice 2.
